### Bug Scenario Images Analysis

### Bug Root Cause
The root cause of the bug is the absence of emulated screen dimensions and deviceScaleFactor in the meta block of the report. The current implementation does not extract or display these values in the tooltip.

### Bug Location
The relevant code for rendering the meta block is located in the `_renderMetaBlock` method of the `ReportRenderer` class in the `report/renderer/report-renderer.js` file. This method currently gathers and displays various environment and configuration settings but does not include the emulated screen dimensions or deviceScaleFactor.
